# nyangine cheatsheet

Every public declaration in the engine, one line each, in the order its header writes it.
Attributes (`__attr_no_discard`, `__attr_overloaded`, ...) are stripped; nothing else is.
The prose after `//` is the first sentence of the declaration's doc comment, kept only when it
fits whole. The header is the manual: this file is the index into it.

Anything spelled `_nya_` or `_NYA_`, or marked `NYA_INTERNAL`, is private and not listed.

See also the [prose](README.md) for why things are shaped the way they are, and the [doxygen reference](doxygen/html/index.html) for what each declaration does. All three are assembled into one deployable tree by `./build docs`.

## Modules

- [`base`](#base) — Arenas, strings, arrays, logging, errors, hashing, files, commands, clocks. No SDL.
- [`core`](#core) — The application loop: entities, systems, events, input, audio, assets, config, saves.
- [`math`](#math) — Scalars, vectors, matrices, quaternions, shapes, noise, random, springs and tweens.
- [`renderer`](#renderer) — 2D and 3D drawing, cameras, text, particles, post processing and render targets.
- [`ui`](#ui) — Immediate mode widgets: panels, rows, buttons, sliders, toggles and focus navigation.
- [`desktop_shell`](#desktop_shell) — Native desktop furniture: open and save file dialogs, message boxes, and a system tray with a menu.
- [`physics`](#physics) — Box2D and Box3D behind one interface: bodies, shapes, queries and a character controller.
- [`net`](#net) — The wire: an encrypted session to a peer over UDP, Steam's relay or a loopback pair.
- [`replicate`](#replicate) — A world on the wire: commands, delta snapshots, prediction, lag compensation, chat.
- [`http`](#http) — An HTTP/1.1 server, its router and layers, JWT auth, and OpenAPI generated from both.
- [`serde`](#serde) — One dynamic value type, serialized to and from json, jsonc and the engine's own format.
- [`crypto`](#crypto) — Hashes, MACs, AEAD, X25519, Ed25519, Argon2id and base32, over monocypher and its vectors.
- [`nn`](#nn) — Tensors, layers, optimizers, DQN and NEAT. A library above math and nothing else.
- [`permission`](#permission) — Who may do what to which thing: roles, ranks, overwrites, one resolver, one audit.
- [`db`](#db) — One database file: bound statements, a reflected struct as a row, derived migrations.
- [`debug`](#debug) — The overlay, the trace, the crash window, and drawing physics shapes and networks.
- [`plugins`](#plugins) — Optional dependencies behind a flag: curl, lua, discord, steam, oidc, pgp, and the ACME client.
- [`platform`](#platform) — What the host is, and how to talk to it: signals, the terminal and ipc.
- [`os`](#os) — The syscalls themselves: files, pages, the two clocks, random bytes, processes.

## base

Arenas, strings, arrays, logging, errors, hashing, files, commands, clocks. No SDL.

### base_basic.h

Most basic includes, macros, and (compile-time) mode/platform/compiler detection.

```c
// types
typedef enum { NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_DEBUG = 0, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_DEVELOPER = 1, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_RELEASE = 2, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_STEAM = 3, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_TEST = 4, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_COUNT, NYA_EXECUTION_MODE_CURRENT = NYA_EXECUTION_MODE, } NYA_ExecutionMode
typedef enum { NYA_COMPILER_NULL, NYA_COMPILER_MSVC, NYA_COMPILER_CLANG, NYA_COMPILER_GCC, NYA_COMPILER_COUNT, NYA_COMPILER_CURRENT = NYA_COMPILER_MSVC, NYA_COMPILER_CURRENT = NYA_COMPILER_CLANG, NYA_COMPILER_CURRENT = NYA_COMPILER_GCC, NYA_COMPILER_CURRENT = NYA_COMPILER_NULL, } NYA_Compiler
typedef enum { NYA_OS_NULL, NYA_OS_WASM, NYA_OS_WINDOWS, NYA_OS_LINUX, NYA_OS_MAC, NYA_OS_COUNT, NYA_OS_CURRENT = NYA_OS_WASM, NYA_OS_CURRENT = NYA_OS_WINDOWS, NYA_OS_CURRENT = NYA_OS_LINUX, NYA_OS_CURRENT = NYA_OS_MAC, NYA_OS_CURRENT = NYA_OS_NULL, } NYA_OperatingSystem
typedef enum { NYA_ARCH_NULL, NYA_ARCH_WASM32, NYA_ARCH_WASM64, NYA_ARCH_X86, NYA_ARCH_X86_64, NYA_ARCH_ARM32, NYA_ARCH_ARM64, NYA_ARCH_COUNT, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_WASM32, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_WASM64, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_X86, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_X86_64, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_ARM32, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_ARM64, NYA_ARCH_CURRENT = NYA_ARCH_NULL, } NYA_Architecture

// macros
NYA_VERSION VERSION
NYA_BUILD_COMMIT "unknown"  // The commit the binary was built from, with `-dirty` appended when the tree had uncommitted changes.
NYA_EXECUTION_MODE 0
NYA_DEBUG (NYA_EXECUTION_MODE == 0)
NYA_DEVELOPER (NYA_EXECUTION_MODE == 1)
NYA_RELEASE (NYA_EXECUTION_MODE == 2)
NYA_STEAM (NYA_EXECUTION_MODE == 3)
NYA_TEST (NYA_EXECUTION_MODE == 4)
NYA_DEVELOPMENT_BUILD (NYA_DEBUG || NYA_DEVELOPER)  // Built to be worked on: hot reloading, filesystem assets, diagnostics that cost something.
NYA_SHIPPING_BUILD (NYA_RELEASE || NYA_STEAM)  // Built to be handed to someone else: bundled assets, integrity checked, no reload machinery.
NYA_CODE_HOT_RELOAD NYA_DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
NYA_TERMINAL_ENABLED 1
NYA_HEADLESS_ENABLED 1
NYA_INTERNAL __attribute__((visibility("hidden"))) static
NYA_INTERNAL_CALLBACK  // Internal, except in a build that reloads code, where the name has to be findable.
NYA_EXTERN extern "C"
NYA_API __declspec(dllexport) NYA_EXTERN
```

### base_bench.h

```c
// macros
NYA_BENCH_WARMUP 3  // How many untimed rounds run first, to fault in pages and settle the branch predictors and caches.
NYA_BENCH_ROUNDS 9  // How many timed rounds each case runs.
NYA_BENCH_MIN_SAMPLE_NS 100'000  // The shortest a timed sample may be, in nanoseconds.
NYA_BENCH_MAX_BATCH 1'000'000  // The most a calibration will batch, so a pathologically fast body cannot spin forever.
nya_bench(name_, items_, ...)  // Times `body`, reporting nanoseconds per iteration and, when `items` is non-zero, per item.
nya_bench_keep(value_)  // Makes a value observable, so the optimiser cannot delete the work that produced it.

// functions
void nya_bench_begin(NYA_ConstCString group)  // Starts a named group and prints its header.
s32 nya_bench_end(void)  // Prints the group's summary and returns a process exit code: zero unless a case failed.
void nya_bench_report(NYA_ConstCString name, f64* samples, u32 sample_count, u64 batch, u64 items)  // Records one case's result.
```

### base_integrity.h

```c
// types
enum NYA_IntegrityStatus { NYA_INTEGRITY_OK, NYA_INTEGRITY_FILE_MODIFIED, NYA_INTEGRITY_CODE_MODIFIED, NYA_INTEGRITY_ASSET_MODIFIED, NYA_INTEGRITY_CHECK_SKIPPED, NYA_INTEGRITY_STATUS_COUNT, }
struct NYA_IntegrityState { atomic u64 executable_mac; atomic b8 baseline_ready; const u8* code; u64 code_size; u64 chunk_bytes; u32 chunk_count; u64 chunk_hashes[NYA_INTEGRITY_CODE_CHUNK_MAX]; u64 baseline_digest; u32 sweep_cursor; u64 sweep_next_ns; u64 sweep_digest; u64 sweep_passes; u64 last_pass_digest; u64 watchdog_ns; u64 watchdog_passes; u64 watchdog_stalled_ns; }  // What the checks share.

// macros
NYA_INTEGRITY_CODE_CHUNK_BYTES (64ULL * 1024ULL)  // Code hashed per sweep step, about 15 µs of SipHash.
NYA_INTEGRITY_CODE_CHUNK_MAX 512
NYA_INTEGRITY_SWEEP_INTERVAL_NS 250'000'000ULL  // Time between sweep steps.
NYA_INTEGRITY_SWEEP_CATCH_UP_MAX 4  // Steps one frame may catch up on after a hitch, so a slow frame does not stretch the pass.
NYA_INTEGRITY_STARTUP_DEADLINE_NS 30'000'000'000ULL  // How long the startup check may take before the watchdog counts it as skipped.
NYA_INTEGRITY_PASS_DEADLINE_FACTOR 4  // How many expected pass durations may go by without a completed pass, on top of the startup deadline.
NYA_INTEGRITY_WATCHDOG_STEP_MAX_NS 1'000'000'000ULL
NYA_INTEGRITY_EXIT_CODE 86  // Distinct from a crash and from a normal exit, so a launcher or a support log can tell what happened.
nya_integrity_watchdog(now_ns)  // The process watchdog: nya_integrity_watchdog_verdict over this process, exiting on anything but OK.

// functions
u64 nya_integrity_hash(const void* data, u64 size)  // The keyed hash every check compares: over the file, over code chunks, over asset entries.
void nya_integrity_fail(NYA_IntegrityStatus status, NYA_ConstCString detail)  // Logs why and exits with NYA_INTEGRITY_EXIT_CODE.
NYA_Error nya_integrity_patch(NYA_ConstCString binary_path, OUT u64* out_mac)  // Stamps the MAC into a freshly linked binary.
b8 nya_integrity_verify_file(NYA_ConstCString path)  // Whether the file at `path` still matches the hash stamped into it.
void nya_integrity_start(void)  // Starts the checks on a thread of their own: verifies the executable file, then captures the code baseline.
void nya_integrity_sweep(u64 now_ns)  // Re-hashes the next code chunks that are due.
void nya_integrity_capture(NYA_IntegrityState* state, const u8* code, u64 size)  // Hashes `size` bytes of `code` into `state` as the baseline.
NYA_IntegrityStatus nya_integrity_sweep_step(NYA_IntegrityState* state)  // One sweep step over `state`: the verdict on the chunk it hashed.
NYA_IntegrityState _nya_integrity_state  // The process's state and whether nya_integrity_start ran.
b8 _nya_integrity_started
u64 _nya_integrity_stamped_mac(void)  // The MAC stamped into this executable, read from memory.
```

### base_logging.h

```c
// types
enum NYA_LogLevel { NYA_LOG_LEVEL_TRACE, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_INFO, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_WARN, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_ERROR, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_PANIC, NYA_LOG_LEVEL_COUNT, }
enum NYA_CrashSource { NYA_CRASH_SOURCE_ASSERT, NYA_CRASH_SOURCE_PANIC, NYA_CRASH_SOURCE_ERROR, NYA_CRASH_SOURCE_FAULT, NYA_CRASH_SOURCE_COUNT, }
struct NYA_CrashInfo { NYA_CrashSource source; NYA_ConstCString function; NYA_ConstCString file; u32 line; s32 signal; u64 fault_address; u32 error_kind; b8 fault_path; u8 message[NYA_CRASH_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH]; NYA_Backtrace backtrace; }  // Everything known about a crash, self contained and copyable.
typedef void (*NYA_CrashObserver)(const NYA_CrashInfo* info, void* user_data)  // Receives every crash, whatever its source.
typedef void (*NYA_LogSink)(NYA_LogLevel level, NYA_ConstCString message, u32 length, void* user_data)  // Receives every formatted log line.
enum NYA_LogFieldKind { NYA_LOG_FIELD_STRING, NYA_LOG_FIELD_INT, NYA_LOG_FIELD_FLOAT, NYA_LOG_FIELD_BOOL, }  // What a field carries.
struct NYA_LogField { NYA_ConstCString key; NYA_LogFieldKind kind; union { NYA_ConstCString as_string; s64 as_int; f64 as_float; b8 as_bool; }; }  // One typed key/value pair on a record.
struct NYA_LogRecord { NYA_LogLevel level; NYA_ConstCString function; NYA_ConstCString file; u32 line; NYA_ConstCString tag; NYA_ConstCString message; const NYA_LogField* fields; u32 field_count; b8 fields_overflowed; }  // A message plus its typed fields, handed to a record sink so the sink decides the rendering.
typedef void (*NYA_LogRecordSink)(const NYA_LogRecord* record, void* user_data)  // Receives every record, message and typed fields together, so the sink alone decides how it reads.

// macros
NYA_CRASH_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH 1024  // Roomy enough that a thrown error can carry its message and its full propagation trace.
NYA_CRASH_OBSERVER_MAX 8
NYA_LOG_SINK_MAX 8
NYA_LOG_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH 2048
NYA_LOG_TAG_MAX_LENGTH 32  // A tag names what a thread is working on, such as a request id, so it is short: 32 bytes with the terminator.
NYA_LOG_FIELD_MAX 16  // Typed fields one record carries beside its message.
NYA_LOG_RING_MAX 256  // Lines the ring holds, and how much of each it keeps.
NYA_LOG_RING_LINE_MAX 256
nya_log_trace(format, ...)
nya_log_debug(format, ...)
nya_log_info(format, ...)
nya_log_warn(format, ...)
nya_log_error(format, ...)
nya_log_panic(format, ...)
nya_log_str(k, v)
nya_log_int(k, v)
nya_log_float(k, v)
nya_log_bool(k, v)
nya_log_trace_fields(message, ...)
nya_log_debug_fields(message, ...)
nya_log_info_fields(message, ...)
nya_log_warn_fields(message, ...)
nya_log_error_fields(message, ...)

// functions
NYA_LogLevel nya_log_level_get(void)
void nya_log_level_set(NYA_LogLevel level)
void nya_log_sink_add(NYA_LogSink sink, void* user_data)  // Adds a log sink.
b8 nya_log_sink_remove(NYA_LogSink sink, void* user_data)  // Removes the sink registered with exactly this callback and user data.
void nya_log_sink_clear(void)
void nya_log_record_sink_add(NYA_LogRecordSink sink, void* user_data)
b8 nya_log_record_sink_remove(NYA_LogRecordSink sink, void* user_data)  // Removes the record sink registered with exactly this callback and user data.
u32 nya_log_record_render_json(const NYA_LogRecord* record, OUT char* out, u64 capacity)
void nya_log_tag_set(NYA_ConstCString tag)  // Tags every line this thread logs until cleared, as `[LEVEL] [tag] function (...)`.
void nya_log_tag_clear(void)
NYA_ConstCString nya_log_tag_get(void)  // The current thread's tag, or "" when there is none.
u32 nya_log_ring_count(void)  // Lines held, at most NYA_LOG_RING_MAX.
NYA_ConstCString nya_log_ring_at(u32 index)  // Line `index`, oldest first.
NYA_LogLevel nya_log_ring_level_at(u32 index)  // The level line `index` was logged at.
void nya_log_ring_clear(void)  // Drops everything the ring holds.
void _nya_log_message(NYA_LogLevel level, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_ConstCString file, u32 line, NYA_ConstCString format, ...)
void _nya_log_fields(NYA_LogLevel level, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_ConstCString file, u32 line, NYA_ConstCString message, const NYA_LogField* fields, u32 count)  // What the nya_log_*_fields macros call.
void _nya_crash_raise(NYA_CrashSource source, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_ConstCString file, u32 line, u32 error_kind, NYA_ConstCString format, ...)  // The central crash sink.
void _nya_crash_raise_with_backtrace( NYA_CrashSource source, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_ConstCString file, u32 line, u32 error_kind, const NYA_Backtrace* backtrace, NYA_ConstCString format, ... )  // Same, but reports `backtrace` instead of capturing one here.
void _nya_crash_raise_fault(s32 signal, u64 fault_address)  // Fault entry point into the same sink.
jmp_buf* _nya_crash_prevent_push(jmp_buf* jmp)  // Arms crash prevention, returning the frame it replaced so it can be restored.
void _nya_crash_prevent_pop(jmp_buf* previous)  // Restores a previously armed frame.
```

### base_rate.h

How often this program may do something, and how long to wait when it may not.

```c
// types
typedef struct { f64 per_second; f64 burst; } NYA_RateLimiterOptions  // What a limiter is made of.
typedef struct { u64 base_ms; u64 cap_ms; f64 jitter; } NYA_BackoffOptions  // What a backoff is shaped like.

// macros
NYA_RATE_MAX_KEY 64  // Bytes of a bucket's name, terminator included.
NYA_RATE_MAX_BUCKETS 32  // Buckets one limiter holds.
NYA_RATE_BACKOFF_BASE_MS 250  // What a backoff starts at and what it never passes, in milliseconds, unless a caller says otherwise.
NYA_RATE_BACKOFF_CAP_MS 30000
NYA_RATE_MAX_WAIT_MS 60000  // The longest one nya_rate_wait will ever sleep for, in milliseconds.
nya_rate_limiter_create(arena, out_limiter, ...)  // Takes the options by name.
nya_backoff_ms(attempt, ...)  // Takes the options by name.

// functions
NYA_Error _nya_rate_limiter_create(NYA_Arena* arena, OUT NYA_RateLimiter** out_limiter, NYA_RateLimiterOptions options)  // Builds a limiter into `arena`.
void nya_rate_limiter_destroy(NYA_RateLimiter* limiter)  // Empties every bucket's history.
b8 nya_rate_take(NYA_RateLimiter* limiter, NYA_ConstCString key, OUT u64* out_wait_ms)  // Spends one call from `key`'s budget if there is one, and says how long until there is if there is not.
u64 nya_rate_wait(NYA_RateLimiter* limiter, NYA_ConstCString key)  // Waits until `key` may go, then spends it.
void nya_rate_told(NYA_RateLimiter* limiter, NYA_ConstCString key, u64 wait_ms)  // What the server said: nothing on `key` until `wait_ms` from now.
void nya_rate_observed(NYA_RateLimiter* limiter, NYA_ConstCString key, f64 remaining, u64 reset_ms)  // What the server said about how much is left, from the headers a reply carries.
u64 nya_rate_wait_for(const NYA_RateLimiter* limiter, NYA_ConstCString key)  // Milliseconds until `key` may go, without spending anything.
u32 nya_rate_bucket_count(const NYA_RateLimiter* limiter)  // How many buckets are in use, for the ceiling audit.
u64 _nya_backoff_ms(u32 attempt, NYA_BackoffOptions options)  // How long to wait before retry number `attempt`, counting from zero.
b8 nya_retry_is_worthwhile(u32 status)  // Whether a failed attempt is worth another go.
```

### base_reconnect.h

When a connection this program owns drops, whether to dial again and how long to wait first.

```c
// types
struct NYA_ReconnectPolicy { b8 enabled; u64 base_ms; u64 cap_ms; u32 max_attempts; f64 jitter; }  // How a reconnect behaves.
struct NYA_Reconnect { NYA_ReconnectPolicy policy; u32 attempt; b8 waiting; u64 retry_at_ms; }  // One connection's reconnect state.

// macros
NYA_RECONNECT_BASE_MS 500  // The first retry's window when the policy leaves `base_ms` at zero.
NYA_RECONNECT_CAP_MS 30000  // The longest a retry ever waits when the policy leaves `cap_ms` at zero.

// functions
void nya_reconnect_init(OUT NYA_Reconnect* reconnect, NYA_ReconnectPolicy policy)  // Sets `reconnect` to a fresh state under `policy`: no attempts spent, nothing scheduled.
b8 nya_reconnect_enabled(const NYA_Reconnect* reconnect)  // Whether the policy is opted in at all.
u64 nya_reconnect_window_ms(const NYA_Reconnect* reconnect)
b8 nya_reconnect_dropped(NYA_Reconnect* reconnect, u64 now_ms)  // An unexpected drop happened at `now_ms`.
b8 nya_reconnect_dropped_after(NYA_Reconnect* reconnect, u64 now_ms, u64 delay_ms)  // nya_reconnect_dropped with the delay supplied rather than drawn from the jittered backoff.
b8 nya_reconnect_due(const NYA_Reconnect* reconnect, u64 now_ms)  // Whether a scheduled retry is due at `now_ms`.
b8 nya_reconnect_waiting(const NYA_Reconnect* reconnect)  // Whether a retry is scheduled and not yet begun.
u64 nya_reconnect_remaining_ms(const NYA_Reconnect* reconnect, u64 now_ms)  // Milliseconds until the scheduled retry, or zero when it is due now or nothing is scheduled.
void nya_reconnect_connected(NYA_Reconnect* reconnect)
```

### base_reflection.h

One generated description per annotated type, and everything generic over a struct it was not

```c
// types
typedef NYA_Error (*NYA_ReflectApplyFn)(void* instance)  // What `@on_apply` names.
enum NYA_ReflectKind { NYA_REFLECT_PRIMITIVE, NYA_REFLECT_STRUCT, NYA_REFLECT_UNION, NYA_REFLECT_ENUM, NYA_REFLECT_ARRAY, NYA_REFLECT_VECTOR, NYA_REFLECT_POINTER, NYA_REFLECT_COUNT, }  // What a described type *is*, which selects which members of NYA_TypeReflection mean anything.
enum NYA_ReflectHint { NYA_HINT_NONE, NYA_HINT_POSITION, NYA_HINT_SCALE, NYA_HINT_EULER, NYA_HINT_COLOR, NYA_HINT_ASSET, NYA_HINT_BITFLAGS, NYA_HINT_COUNT, }  // What a field *means*, where its type does not say.
struct NYA_ReflectAttribute { NYA_ConstCString name; NYA_ConstCString args; }  // One `@name` or `@name(args)` annotation, kept verbatim from the source.
struct NYA_ReflectField { NYA_ConstCString name; const NYA_TypeReflection* type; u64 offset; NYA_ReflectHint hint; b8 is_key; b8 is_redacted; b8 is_secret; const NYA_ReflectAttribute* attributes; u32 attribute_count; b8 has_tag_value; s64 tag_value; }  // One member of a struct or union.
struct NYA_ReflectVariant { NYA_ConstCString name; s64 value; }  // One variant of an enum.
struct NYA_TypeReflection { NYA_ConstCString name; NYA_ReflectKind kind; u64 size; u64 alignment; NYA_Type primitive; const NYA_ReflectField* fields; u32 field_count; const NYA_ReflectField* tag_field; const NYA_ReflectVariant* variants; u32 variant_count; b8 is_bitflags; const NYA_TypeReflection* element; u32 element_count; NYA_ReflectApplyFn on_apply; const NYA_ReflectAttribute* attributes; u32 attribute_count; }  // Everything known about one type.
typedef void (*NYA_ReflectReportFn)(NYA_ConstCString path, NYA_ConstCString found, NYA_ConstCString expected, void* user_data)  // One problem found in a document.

// macros
NYA_REFLECT_REDACTED "<redacted>"  // What nya_reflect_to_object_redacted writes in place of a `@redact` field.
nya_reflect_of(type)  // The reflection for `type`, by its bare name: `nya_reflect_of(NYA_Entity)`.
NYA_REFLECT_LAYOUT_DEPTH_MAX 32  // Deepest nesting of described types the hash walks.
NYA_REFLECT_PATH_MAX 256  // Longest dotted path a report carries, terminator included.

// functions
const NYA_ReflectField* nya_reflect_field(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, NYA_ConstCString name)  // The field called `name`, or null.
const NYA_ReflectAttribute* nya_reflect_field_attribute(const NYA_ReflectField* field, NYA_ConstCString name)  // The attribute called `name` on `field`, or null.
b8 nya_reflect_field_has_attribute(const NYA_ReflectField* field, NYA_ConstCString name)  // Whether `field` carries the attribute `name` (without the leading `@`).
const NYA_ReflectAttribute* nya_reflect_type_attribute(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, NYA_ConstCString name)  // The attribute called `name` on the type itself, or null.
const NYA_ReflectField* nya_reflect_path(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, NYA_ConstCString path, void* instance, OUT void** out_instance)  // The field at a dotted path such as `"visual.color.r"`, resolving through nested structs.
void* nya_reflect_field_pointer(void* instance, const NYA_ReflectField* field)  // The address of `field` within `instance`.
NYA_ConstCString nya_reflect_variant_name(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, s64 value)  // The name of the variant with `value`, or null.
b8 nya_reflect_variant_value(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, NYA_ConstCString name, OUT s64* out_value)  // The value of the variant called `name`.
b8 nya_reflect_is_char_array(const NYA_TypeReflection* type)
u64 nya_reflect_layout_hash(const NYA_TypeReflection* type)  // The layout hash of `type`.
b8 nya_reflect_value_to_s64(NYA_Value value, OUT s64* out_value)
b8 nya_reflect_value_to_f64(NYA_Value value, OUT f64* out_value)  // The same for a real.
NYA_Value nya_reflect_read(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, const void* instance)  // Reads one primitive field out of `instance` as an NYA_Value.
b8 nya_reflect_write(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, void* instance, NYA_Value value)  // The inverse.
NYA_Object* nya_reflect_to_object(NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_TypeReflection* type, const void* instance)  // Any annotated type, as a self describing document.
NYA_Error nya_reflect_from_object(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, void* instance, const NYA_Object* object)  // The inverse, in place.
NYA_Object* nya_reflect_to_object_redacted(NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_TypeReflection* type, const void* instance)
u32 nya_reflect_check(const NYA_TypeReflection* type, const NYA_Object* object, NYA_ReflectReportFn report, void* user_data)
```

### base_supervisor.h

When the process dies on a fatal, whether to relaunch it and how long to wait first.

```c
// types
struct NYA_SupervisorPolicy { b8 enabled; u32 max_restarts; u64 window_s; u64 base_ms; u64 cap_ms; f64 jitter; }  // How a supervisor behaves.
struct NYA_Supervisor { NYA_SupervisorPolicy policy; u32 restarts; u64 window_start_s; }  // The supervisor's state.

// macros
NYA_SUPERVISOR_MAX_RESTARTS 5  // Restarts allowed inside one window when the policy leaves `max_restarts` at zero.
NYA_SUPERVISOR_WINDOW_S 60  // The rolling window the restarts are counted in, in seconds, when the policy leaves `window_s` at zero.
NYA_SUPERVISOR_BASE_MS 500  // The first restart's backoff window when the policy leaves `base_ms` at zero.
NYA_SUPERVISOR_CAP_MS 30000  // The longest a restart ever waits when the policy leaves `cap_ms` at zero.

// functions
void nya_supervisor_init(OUT NYA_Supervisor* supervisor, NYA_SupervisorPolicy policy)  // Sets `supervisor` to a fresh state under `policy`: no restarts spent, no window open.

b8 nya_supervisor_should_restart(NYA_Supervisor* supervisor, u64 now_s, b8 clean_exit)  // Whether the process should be relaunched after a fatal at `now_s`, counting this restart if so.
u64 nya_supervisor_window_ms(const NYA_Supervisor* supervisor)
u64 nya_supervisor_backoff_ms(const NYA_Supervisor* supervisor)
u32 nya_supervisor_restart_count(const NYA_Supervisor* supervisor)  // Restarts counted in the current window.
void nya_supervisor_arm(s32 argc, NYA_CString* argv)
```

### base_url.h

URLs and percent encoding, parsed once where the text arrives.

```c
// types
enum NYA_UrlScheme { NYA_URL_SCHEME_NONE = 0, NYA_URL_SCHEME_HTTP, NYA_URL_SCHEME_HTTPS, NYA_URL_SCHEME_WS, NYA_URL_SCHEME_WSS, NYA_URL_SCHEME_COUNT, }  // The schemes this engine speaks.
enum NYA_UrlHostKind { NYA_URL_HOST_NONE = 0, NYA_URL_HOST_NAME, NYA_URL_HOST_IPV4, NYA_URL_HOST_IPV6, NYA_URL_HOST_COUNT, }  // What the host turned out to be.
enum NYA_UrlRule { NYA_URL_RULE_NONE = 0, NYA_URL_RULE_EMPTY, NYA_URL_RULE_TOO_LONG, NYA_URL_RULE_CONTROL_CHARACTER, NYA_URL_RULE_SPACE, NYA_URL_RULE_CHARACTER, NYA_URL_RULE_PERCENT_MALFORMED, NYA_URL_RULE_SCHEME_MISSING, NYA_URL_RULE_SCHEME_UNKNOWN, NYA_URL_RULE_AUTHORITY_MISSING, NYA_URL_RULE_HOST_EMPTY, NYA_URL_RULE_HOST_TOO_LONG, NYA_URL_RULE_HOST_MALFORMED, NYA_URL_RULE_IPV6_MALFORMED, NYA_URL_RULE_PORT_MALFORMED, NYA_URL_RULE_PORT_OUT_OF_RANGE, NYA_URL_RULE_PATH_NOT_ABSOLUTE, NYA_URL_RULE_PATH_ENCODED_SLASH, NYA_URL_RULE_PATH_DOT_SEGMENT, NYA_URL_RULE_PATH_DOUBLE_SLASH, NYA_URL_RULE_COUNT, }  // Which rule a refused URL broke.
struct NYA_UrlSpan { u16 offset; u16 length; }  // A component: where it sits in NYA_Url.text and how long it is.
struct NYA_Url { NYA_UrlScheme scheme; NYA_UrlHostKind host_kind; b8 has_userinfo; b8 has_port; b8 has_query; b8 has_fragment; u16 port; NYA_UrlSpan host; NYA_UrlSpan path; NYA_UrlSpan query; NYA_UrlSpan fragment; u16 length; char text[NYA_URL_MAX_BYTES]; }  // A URL that parsed.
struct NYA_UrlFailure { NYA_UrlRule rule; u32 offset; }  // Which rule a refusal broke and the byte of the input it broke it at.

// macros
NYA_URL_MAX_BYTES 2048  // Longest URL accepted, in bytes.
NYA_URL_HOST_MAX_BYTES 253  // Longest host name.
NYA_URL_HOST_LABEL_MAX_BYTES 63  // Longest label between two dots of a host name, from RFC 1035.
NYA_URL_IPV6_MAX_BYTES 45  // Longest IPv6 literal inside the brackets: eight groups of four, or six and an embedded dotted quad.
NYA_URL_PORT_MAX_DIGITS 5  // Digits in a port.

// functions
NYA_Error nya_url_parse(const char* text, u64 size, OUT NYA_Url* out_url, OUT NYA_UrlFailure* out_failure)  // Parses an absolute URL with one of the schemes in NYA_UrlScheme.
NYA_Error nya_url_parse_target(const char* text, u64 size, OUT NYA_Url* out_url, OUT NYA_UrlFailure* out_failure)
NYA_Error nya_url_format(const NYA_Url* url, OUT char* buffer, u64 capacity, OUT u64* out_length)  // Renders `url` into `buffer`, null terminated, `out_length` not counting the terminator.
NYA_Error nya_url_path_decode(const NYA_Url* url, OUT char* buffer, u64 capacity, OUT u64* out_length)  // The path, percent-decoded and null terminated.
NYA_Error nya_url_query_find(const NYA_Url* url, NYA_ConstCString name, OUT char* buffer, u64 capacity, OUT b8* out_found)
NYA_ConstCString nya_url_rule_text(NYA_UrlRule rule)  // The rule's name, for a log line.
NYA_Error nya_percent_encode(const u8* data, u64 size, OUT char* buffer, u64 capacity, OUT u64* out_length)
NYA_Error nya_percent_decode(const char* text, u64 size, OUT u8* buffer, u64 capacity, OUT u64* out_length)
```

### base_watch.h

What the program's variables held, so a crash report says more than where it stopped.

```c
// types
enum NYA_WatchType { NYA_WATCH_TYPE_SIGNED, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_UNSIGNED, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_FLOAT, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_BOOL, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_CHAR, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_CSTRING, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_STRING, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_POINTER, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_OPAQUE, NYA_WATCH_TYPE_COUNT, }  // How a value is written down.
struct NYA_WatchEntry { u32 frame; NYA_ConstCString function; NYA_ConstCString name; NYA_ConstCString type_name; const void* address; NYA_WatchType type; u32 size; }  // One live variable.

// macros
NYA_WATCH_STRING_MAX 64  // How much of a string is written down.
NYA_WATCH_VALUE_MAX 192  // Longest rendered value, terminator included: the string above, its quotes, its length and an address.
NYA_WATCH_RING_MAX 64  // Entries one thread's ring holds.
nya_assert_eq(left, right)  // The comparison assertions.
nya_assert_ne(left, right)
nya_assert_lt(left, right)
nya_assert_le(left, right)
nya_assert_gt(left, right)
nya_assert_ge(left, right)
nya_watch(function)  // Registers the function's own locals, from where it is written to wherever the function returns.

// functions
u32 nya_watch_value_format(NYA_WatchType type, u32 size, const void* address, OUT u8* buffer, u32 capacity)  // Writes what lives at `address` into `buffer` as terminated text, and returns its length.
u32 nya_watch_frame_begin(void)  // Opens a frame's group.
void nya_watch_frame_end(u32 frame)  // Drops everything registered since the mark, whether this frame registered it or a callee leaked it.
void nya_watch_record(u32 frame, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_ConstCString name, NYA_ConstCString type_name, NYA_WatchType type, u32 size, const void* address)  // Registers one variable into the calling thread's ring.
u32 nya_watch_count(void)  // Entries that can still be read, oldest first: index 0 is the outermost frame's first local.
const NYA_WatchEntry* nya_watch_at(u32 index)  // Entry `index`, or null past the count.
u32 nya_watch_dropped(void)  // How many entries the ring dropped to make room.
```

The application loop: entities, systems, events, input, audio, assets, config, saves.

```c
struct NYA_AudioPass { f32 lowpass_hz; f32 highpass_hz; f32 resonance; f32 glide_ms; }  // Resonant twelve decibel per octave filters at either end of the band.
struct NYA_AudioEqualizer { f32 low_db; f32 mid_db; f32 high_db; f32 low_hz; f32 mid_hz; f32 high_hz; f32 mid_q; }  // Low shelf, mid bell, high shelf.
struct NYA_AudioCompressor { b8 enabled; f32 threshold_db; f32 ratio; f32 attack_ms; f32 release_ms; f32 makeup_db; }  // Turns down whatever is louder than the threshold, linked across channels so the image does not shift.
struct NYA_AudioEcho { b8 enabled; f32 delay_ms; f32 feedback; f32 wet; f32 lowpass_hz; }  // A feedback delay: repeats that fade and dull with each pass.
struct NYA_AudioReverb { f32 room_size; f32 damping; f32 wet; f32 dry; f32 width; }  // A room around a bus: how big it sounds and how much of it is heard.
struct NYA_AudioLimiter { b8 enabled; f32 ceiling_db; f32 release_ms; }  // Holds peaks under a ceiling.
struct NYA_AudioEffects { NYA_AudioPass pass; NYA_AudioEqualizer equalizer; NYA_AudioCompressor compressor; NYA_AudioEcho echo; NYA_AudioReverb reverb; NYA_AudioLimiter limiter; }  // A bus's whole chain.
struct NYA_AudioReflectionTap { f32 delay_s; f32 gain; f32 pan; f32 lowpass_hz; }  // One echo off something around the listener.
struct NYA_AudioReflections { NYA_AudioReflectionTap taps[NYA_AUDIO_REFLECTION_TAPS]; }  // The listener's echoes, written by propagation.

// macros
NYA_AUDIO_EFFECTS_BLOCK 32  // Frames between parameter steps.
NYA_AUDIO_EFFECTS_SMOOTHING_MS 20.0F  // How long a parameter takes to reach a new setting, milliseconds, unless the unit says otherwise.
NYA_AUDIO_EFFECTS_MAX_CHANNELS 8  // Speaker channels a chain processes.
NYA_AUDIO_PASS_RESONANCE 0.7071F
NYA_AUDIO_EQUALIZER_LOW_HZ 200.0F
NYA_AUDIO_EQUALIZER_MID_HZ 1000.0F
NYA_AUDIO_EQUALIZER_HIGH_HZ 5000.0F
NYA_AUDIO_EQUALIZER_MID_Q 0.7F
NYA_AUDIO_COMPRESSOR_THRESHOLD_DB (-18.0F)
NYA_AUDIO_COMPRESSOR_RATIO 4.0F
NYA_AUDIO_COMPRESSOR_ATTACK_MS 10.0F
NYA_AUDIO_COMPRESSOR_RELEASE_MS 120.0F
NYA_AUDIO_LIMITER_CEILING_DB (-1.0F)
NYA_AUDIO_LIMITER_RELEASE_MS 80.0F
NYA_AUDIO_ECHO_DELAY_MS 320.0F
NYA_AUDIO_ECHO_FEEDBACK 0.35F
NYA_AUDIO_ECHO_WET 0.3F
NYA_AUDIO_ECHO_LOWPASS_HZ 3500.0F
NYA_AUDIO_ECHO_FRAMES 32768  // Frames an echo line holds per channel, a power of two.
NYA_AUDIO_REFLECTION_TAPS 6  // Echoes of the listener's surroundings per bus.
NYA_AUDIO_REFLECTION_FRAMES 16384  // Frames the reflection line holds, a power of two.

// functions
void nya_audio_bus_effects_set(NYA_AudioBus bus, NYA_AudioEffects effects)  // Sets a bus's chain.
NYA_AudioEffects nya_audio_bus_effects_get(NYA_AudioBus bus)  // What the bus was last set to, validated.
```

### core_audio_panner.h

A stereo panner: it places one sound in the stereo field from where it sits relative to the listener,

```c
// types
struct NYA_StereoPanParams { f32 azimuth_radians; f32 head_radius_m; f32 speed_of_sound_mps; f32 shadow_hz; }  // Where a sound is, as one angle in the listener's own frame.
struct NYA_StereoPan { f32 left_gain; f32 right_gain; f32 left_delay_s; f32 right_delay_s; f32 left_lowpass_hz; f32 right_lowpass_hz; }  // The per-ear placement of one sound.
struct NYA_AudioPanRender { f32 ring[2][NYA_AUDIO_PAN_MAX_DELAY_FRAMES]; u32 write_index; f32 shadow_state[2]; f32 gain[2]; f32 coefficient[2]; b8 primed; }

// macros
NYA_AUDIO_PAN_HEAD_RADIUS_M 0.0875F  // Radius of the average human head, metres.
NYA_AUDIO_PAN_SPEED_OF_SOUND_MPS 343.0F  // Speed of sound in air, metres per second.
NYA_AUDIO_PAN_SHADOW_HZ 1800.0F  // Where the far ear is rolled off when a source is hard to one side, hertz.
NYA_AUDIO_PAN_REAR_SHADOW_HZ 6500.0F  // Where both ears are rolled off when a source is directly behind, hertz.
NYA_AUDIO_PAN_MAX_DELAY_FRAMES 64  // Frames the interaural delay line holds per ear.

// functions
NYA_StereoPan nya_audio_pan_compute(NYA_StereoPanParams params)  // The panning law, delay and shadow for one azimuth.
f32 nya_audio_pan_azimuth(f32x3 listener_relative)  // The azimuth of a direction in the mixer's listener frame: +x right, +y up, -z ahead.
void nya_audio_pan_render_reset(NYA_AudioPanRender* render)  // Clears the delay line and filter history and drops the smoothing, so the next buffer snaps to its target.
void nya_audio_pan_render(NYA_AudioPanRender* render, f32 sample_rate_hz, s32 channels, NYA_StereoPan target, f32* pcm, s32 samples)
```

### core_audio_propagation.h

```c
// types
typedef void (*NYA_AudioRayFn)(const NYA_AudioRay* rays, f32* out_fractions, u32 count, void* user_data)
enum NYA_AudioSpace { NYA_AUDIO_SPACE_3D, NYA_AUDIO_SPACE_2D, NYA_AUDIO_SPACE_COUNT, }  // Which listener is the ear, which voices are traced, and which ray function answers.
struct NYA_AudioRay { f32x3 origin; f32x3 direction; }  // A segment: `origin` to `origin + direction`.
struct NYA_AudioPropagation { b8 enabled; NYA_AudioSpace space; u32 ray_budget; u32 voice_rays; f32 radius; f32 lowpass_hz; f32 transmission; f32 thickness; f32 smoothing_ms; b8 diffraction; f32 diffraction_reach; b8 environment; f32 environment_range; f32 reflections; f32 speed_of_sound; }  // How sound finds its way through the world.
struct NYA_AudioEnvironment { f32 enclosure; f32 distance; NYA_AudioReverb reverb; }  // The room as the listener's probes see it, and the reverb derived from it.
struct NYA_AudioPath { f32 gain; f32 muffle; f32x3 offset; f32 target_gain; f32 target_muffle; f32x3 target_offset; f32 occlusion; f32 blocker; b8 traced; }  // What propagation does to one voice.
struct NYA_AudioTracer { NYA_AudioPath paths[NYA_AUDIO_VOICES]; NYA_AudioRay rays[NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_RAYS_MAX]; f32 fractions[NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_RAYS_MAX]; f32 environment_fractions[NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_ENVIRONMENT_RAYS]; u32 environment_cursor; NYA_AudioEnvironment environment; NYA_AudioReflections reflections; u32 voice_cursor; u32 rays_cast; }  // Propagation's state, embedded in the audio system.

// macros
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_RAYS_MAX 256  // The most rays one update may cast, whatever NYA_AudioPropagation.ray_budget asks.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_RAY_BUDGET 64  // Rays per update when NYA_AudioPropagation.ray_budget is zero.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_VOICE_RAYS_MAX 8  // The most rays spread over one voice's extent.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_VOICE_RAYS 4  // Rays over one voice's extent when NYA_AudioPropagation.voice_rays is zero.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_PROBES 4  // Places beside a blocker tried for a way around it, two rays each.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_ENVIRONMENT_RAYS 14  // Fixed listener directions the room is measured along.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_ENVIRONMENT_SLICE 4  // Of those, how many are re-cast each update.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_RADIUS 0.25F  // World units the rays spread over, for a voice played without NYA_SoundParams.radius.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_LOWPASS_HZ 900.0F  // Cutoff through one thin surface, hertz.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_TRANSMISSION 0.4F  // Level through one thin surface.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_THICKNESS 2.0F  // World units of solid that cut the transmitted level to about a third.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_DIFFRACTION_REACH 2.0F  // How far beside a blocker a way around is looked for, world units.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_SMOOTHING_MS 90.0F  // How long a voice's level, tone and direction take to settle, milliseconds.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_ENVIRONMENT_RANGE 30.0F  // How far the room probes reach, world units.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_ENVIRONMENT_GLIDE_MS 600.0F  // How long the room estimate takes to follow the listener into another space, milliseconds.
NYA_AUDIO_PROPAGATION_SPEED_OF_SOUND 343.0F  // World units per second.

// functions
void nya_system_audio_update(f32 delta_time_s)  // Traces every positional voice of the configured space and applies the result.
void nya_audio_propagation_set(NYA_AudioPropagation propagation)  // Turns propagation on, off or retunes it.
NYA_AudioPropagation nya_audio_propagation_get(void)
void nya_audio_rays_set(NYA_AudioSpace space, NYA_AudioRayFn function, void* user_data)  // Installs what answers rays for a space.
NYA_AudioEnvironment nya_audio_environment_get(void)  // The room estimate, eased.
NYA_AudioPath nya_audio_voice_path_get(NYA_SoundVoice voice)  // What propagation is doing to a voice.
```

### core_control.h

The control surface: a local socket another process drives this one through.

```c
// types
enum NYA_ControlPermission { NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_READ = 0, NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_WRITE = 1 << 0, NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_DISPATCH = 1 << 1, NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_ALL = NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_WRITE | NYA_CONTROL_PERMISSION_DISPATCH, }  // What a connected process is allowed to do.
struct NYA_ControlConfig { NYA_IpcName name; u32 max_connections; NYA_ControlPermission permissions; }

// macros

NYA_CONTROL_HEADER_BYTES 4  // Bytes of the length prefix in front of every message.
NYA_CONTROL_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES  // Largest message in either direction.
NYA_CONTROL_MAX_MESSAGES_PER_TICK 64  // Messages handled in one tick, across all connections.
NYA_CONTROL_MAX_EXPOSED 32  // Structs that can be exposed at once.
NYA_CONTROL_MAX_EXPOSED_NAME 32  // Longest exposed name, the terminator included.

// functions

b8 nya_control_is_running(void)
NYA_ConstCString nya_control_endpoint(void)  // Where the socket is, or null when it is not running.
u32 nya_control_connection_count(void)
NYA_Error nya_control_frame_encode(u64 size, OUT u8 out_header[NYA_CONTROL_HEADER_BYTES])  // Writes the length prefix for a message of `size` bytes into `out_header`.
b8 nya_control_frame_decode(const u8* data, u64 size, OUT u64* out_length)  // Reads the length prefix at the front of `data`.
```

```c
void nya_input_text_area_set(NYA_WindowHandle window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height)  // Where the caret is, so the IME candidate window can appear beside it.
NYA_ConstCString nya_clipboard_text(NYA_Arena* arena)  // The system clipboard's text, copied into `arena`, or an empty string.
NYA_Error nya_clipboard_text_set(NYA_ConstCString text)  // Puts `text` on the system clipboard.
b8 nya_clipboard_has_text(void)  // Whether the clipboard holds any text.
```

```c
struct NYA_JobSystem { NYA_Arena* allocator; NYA_Mutex* job_queue_mutex; NYA_HeapᐸNYA_Jobᐳ* job_queue; NYA_Mutex* job_active_mutex; NYA_Job job_slots[_NYA_JOB_MAX_ACTIVE]; b8 job_slot_used[_NYA_JOB_MAX_ACTIVE]; u32 job_active_count; NYA_JobHandle next_job_handle; NYA_Thread* scheduler; atomic b8 scheduler_should_exit; }
```

```c
// types
struct NYA_NavPoint { s32 x, y; }  // A cell coordinate.
struct NYA_NavOptions { b8 diagonal; b8 cut_corners; u32 max_nodes; }
struct NYA_NavGrid { NYA_Arena* allocator; u32 width, height; u8* cost; u32* g_score; u32* came_from; u32* visit_stamp; u32* open_heap; u32* open_score; u32 stamp; }
struct NYA_NavFlow { NYA_Arena* allocator; const NYA_NavGrid* grid; u32* distance; u32* queue; NYA_NavPoint goal; b8 built; }

// macros
NYA_NAV_BLOCKED 0  // A cell nothing may enter.
NYA_NAV_COST_DEFAULT 1  // What an ordinary, unremarkable cell costs.
NYA_NAV_UNREACHABLE 0xFFFFFFFFU  // Returned by nya_nav_flow_distance for a cell the goal cannot reach.

// functions
NYA_Error nya_nav_grid_create(NYA_Arena* arena, u32 width, u32 height, OUT NYA_NavGrid** out_grid)  // An empty grid where every cell costs NYA_NAV_COST_DEFAULT.
NYA_Error nya_nav_grid_from_tilemap(NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_Tilemap* map, NYA_ConstCString solid_layer, OUT NYA_NavGrid** out_grid)  // A grid derived from a tilemap layer: any non-empty tile on `solid_layer` is blocked.
void nya_nav_cost_set(NYA_NavGrid* grid, s32 x, s32 y, u8 cost)
u8 nya_nav_cost_at(const NYA_NavGrid* grid, s32 x, s32 y)
b8 nya_nav_walkable(const NYA_NavGrid* grid, s32 x, s32 y)
void nya_nav_fill(NYA_NavGrid* grid, u8 cost)  // Sets every cell to `cost`.
u32 nya_nav_path(NYA_NavGrid* grid, NYA_NavPoint from, NYA_NavPoint to, OUT NYA_NavPoint* out_path, u32 capacity, NYA_NavOptions options)  // Finds a path from `from` to `to`, writing it into `out_path` including both ends.
NYA_Error nya_nav_flow_create(NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_NavGrid* grid, OUT NYA_NavFlow** out_flow)  // A flow field over `grid`.
void nya_nav_flow_build(NYA_NavFlow* flow, NYA_NavPoint goal)  // Recomputes the field for `goal`: one Dijkstra sweep outward, after which every agent is a lookup.
u32 nya_nav_flow_distance(const NYA_NavFlow* flow, s32 x, s32 y)  // Total cost from `point` to the goal, or NYA_NAV_UNREACHABLE.
NYA_NavPoint nya_nav_flow_step(const NYA_NavFlow* flow, NYA_NavPoint from)  // The neighbouring cell to step into from `from`, or `from` itself at the goal or when stuck.
f32x2 nya_nav_flow_direction(const NYA_NavFlow* flow, NYA_NavPoint from)  // The same step as a normalised direction, or zero when there is nowhere to go.
```

### core_plugin.h

Lua plugins: a directory on disk becomes a manifest, a permission set and a VM of its own, and the

```c
// types
enum NYA_PluginPermission : u64
enum NYA_PluginPermission : u64 { NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_NONE = 0, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_UI = 1ULL << 0, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_INPUT = 1ULL << 1, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_KEYBINDING = 1ULL << 2, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_ENTITIES = 1ULL << 3, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_AUDIO = 1ULL << 4, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_ASSETS = 1ULL << 5, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_FILESYSTEM = 1ULL << 6, NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_NETWORK = 1ULL << 7, }  // What a plugin may touch.
struct NYA_PluginDependency { char name[NYA_PLUGIN_NAME_MAX]; char version[NYA_PLUGIN_VERSION_MAX]; }  // One entry of a manifest's `dependencies` or `conflicts` list.
struct NYA_PluginManifest { char name[NYA_PLUGIN_NAME_MAX]; char version[NYA_PLUGIN_VERSION_MAX]; char engine_version[NYA_PLUGIN_VERSION_MAX]; char author[NYA_PLUGIN_AUTHOR_MAX]; char license[NYA_PLUGIN_LICENSE_MAX]; char description[NYA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION_MAX]; char repository[NYA_PLUGIN_URL_MAX]; NYA_PluginPermission permissions; NYA_PluginDependency dependencies[NYA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_MAX]; NYA_PluginDependency conflicts[NYA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_MAX]; }
struct NYA_Plugin { NYA_PluginManifest manifest; char directory[NYA_PLUGIN_PATH_MAX]; NYA_PluginPermission permissions; b8 enabled; u32 error_count; b8 has_frame; b8 has_tick; b8 has_render; void* _state; }  // One loaded plugin.

// macros
NYA_PLUGIN_DIRECTORY "./plugins"  // Where nya_plugin_load_all looks.
NYA_PLUGIN_MAX 8  // How many plugins may be loaded at once.
NYA_PLUGIN_ERROR_MAX 8  // Errors one plugin may raise before it is disabled.
NYA_PLUGIN_NAME_MAX 64  // Names, versions and prose in a manifest, terminator included.
NYA_PLUGIN_VERSION_MAX 32
NYA_PLUGIN_AUTHOR_MAX 96
NYA_PLUGIN_LICENSE_MAX 48
NYA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION_MAX 192
NYA_PLUGIN_URL_MAX 192
NYA_PLUGIN_PATH_MAX 512  // A path this module builds: `plugins/<name>/src/<file>.lua` plus room for a deep working directory.
NYA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCY_MAX 8  // Dependencies and conflicts one manifest may name.
NYA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_MAX 32  // Files under `src/` one plugin may have.
NYA_PLUGIN_CANDIDATE_MAX (NYA_PLUGIN_MAX * 4)
NYA_PLUGIN_QUALIFIED_MAX (NYA_PLUGIN_NAME_MAX + NYA_PLUGIN_NAME_MAX + 1)  // A qualified name: `<plugin>:<name>`, terminator included.
NYA_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE "manifest.nya"
NYA_PLUGIN_ENTRY_FILE "main.lua"
NYA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIRECTORY "src"
NYA_PLUGIN_ASSET_DIRECTORY "assets"
NYA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_EXTENSION ".lua"
NYA_PLUGIN_HOOK_LOAD "on_load"
NYA_PLUGIN_HOOK_UNLOAD "on_unload"
NYA_PLUGIN_HOOK_FRAME "on_frame"
NYA_PLUGIN_HOOK_TICK "on_tick"
NYA_PLUGIN_HOOK_RENDER "on_render"
NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE_LOCKED 0  // Nothing but logging and the clock.
NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE_UI 1  // Draw and read, change nothing: UI and input state, no key bindings, no entities.
NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE_GAMEPLAY 2  // UI, key bindings, entities, audio and the engine's assets.
NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE_ALL 3  // Everything, the plugin's own directory and the network included.
NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE_UI  // Conservative by default: a build that says nothing gets plugins that can draw and read and change nothing.

// functions
NYA_PluginPermission nya_plugin_permissions_granted(void)  // Everything this build lets a plugin have, derived from NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_PROFILE at compile time.
NYA_ConstCString nya_plugin_permission_name(NYA_PluginPermission permission)  // One permission as a manifest spells it: "NYA_PLUGIN_PERMISSION_UI".
NYA_Error nya_plugin_manifest_load(NYA_ConstCString directory, OUT NYA_PluginManifest* out_manifest)
NYA_Error nya_plugin_load_all(void)  // Loads every plugin directory under NYA_PLUGIN_DIRECTORY, dependencies before dependents.
NYA_Error nya_plugin_load(NYA_ConstCString directory)
void nya_plugin_unload(NYA_ConstCString name)  // Unloads the plugin called `name`: `on_unload`, then its systems, then its VM and its arena.
void nya_plugin_unload_all(void)  // Unloads everything, in reverse load order, so a dependency outlives its dependents.
void nya_plugin_enable(NYA_ConstCString name)  // Whether the plugin's per-frame hooks run.
void nya_plugin_disable(NYA_ConstCString name)
b8 nya_plugin_is_enabled(NYA_ConstCString name)  // What those two last set.
u32 nya_plugin_count(void)  // How many plugins are loaded.
const NYA_Plugin* nya_plugin_at(u32 index)  // The plugin at `index`, in load order.
const NYA_Plugin* nya_plugin_find(NYA_ConstCString name)  // The plugin called `name`, or null.
NYA_ConstCString nya_plugin_current(void)  // Which plugin's code is running right now, or null when the answer is the engine or the game.
NYA_SystemOwnerStats nya_plugin_stats(NYA_ConstCString name)  // What `name`'s systems cost, straight out of the system registry's per-owner accounting.
NYA_Error nya_plugin_call( NYA_ConstCString name, NYA_ConstCString function, NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_Value* arguments, u32 argument_count, OUT NYA_Value* out_result )
void nya_plugin_error(NYA_ConstCString name, NYA_ConstCString what, NYA_ConstCString detail)
NYA_ConstCString nya_plugin_qualify(NYA_ConstCString plugin, NYA_ConstCString name, OUT char* out, u64 capacity)  // Writes `<plugin>:<name>` into `out`, which is how every name a plugin hands to an engine registry is spelled.
```

```c
s32 nya_blend_tree_2d(NYA_BlendTree* tree, u32 parameter_x, u32 parameter_y)  // Adds a 2D blend node driven by two parameters.
```

```c
struct NYA_SkeletonInertializer { const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton; NYA_InertialChannel translation[NYA_SKELETON_MAX_BONES]; NYA_InertialChannel rotation[NYA_SKELETON_MAX_BONES]; NYA_InertialChannel scale[NYA_SKELETON_MAX_BONES]; f32 elapsed_s; f32 longest_s; NYA_SkeletonPose previous; NYA_SkeletonPose before_previous; f32 previous_delta_s; u32 history_frames; }

// functions
void nya_skeleton_inertializer_init(NYA_SkeletonInertializer* inertializer, const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton)  // Points it at a skeleton and clears everything, history included.
void nya_skeleton_inertializer_transition(NYA_SkeletonInertializer* inertializer, const NYA_SkeletonPose* target, const NYA_SkeletonPose* target_previous, f32 duration_s)  // Captures the offset between what was last on screen and `target`, to be decayed over `duration_s`.
void nya_skeleton_inertializer_update(NYA_SkeletonInertializer* inertializer, f32 delta_time_s, NYA_SkeletonPose* pose)  // Adds the decaying offset to `pose` in place, and records it as history.
```

```c
// types

struct NYA_SkeletonLayer { NYA_SkeletonAnimator animator; const NYA_SkeletonMask* mask; f32 weight; b8 active; }  // One clip playing over the base, through a mask.
struct NYA_SkeletonPlayOptions { b8 looping; f32 fade_s; f32 speed; b8 restart; }  // What `nya_skeleton_player_play` accepts beyond the clip.
struct NYA_SkeletonEvent { f32 time_s; u32 id; }  // A frame marker on a clip, mirroring NYA_SpriteAnimationEvent so 2D and 3D read alike.
typedef enum NYA_SkeletonSignalKind { NYA_SKELETON_SIGNAL_EVENT = 0, NYA_SKELETON_SIGNAL_LOOPED, NYA_SKELETON_SIGNAL_FINISHED, NYA_SKELETON_SIGNAL_KIND_COUNT, } NYA_SkeletonSignalKind  // What a player reports happened this update.
struct NYA_SkeletonSignal { NYA_SkeletonSignalKind kind; u32 id; const NYA_SkeletonClip* clip; }
struct NYA_SkeletonPlayer { const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton; NYA_SkeletonAnimator current; NYA_SkeletonAnimator previous; f32 fade_elapsed_s; f32 fade_duration_s; b8 fading; b8 current_fresh; NYA_SkeletonInertializer* inertializer; f32 pending_inertial_s; NYA_SkeletonLayer layers[NYA_SKELETON_LAYERS]; const NYA_SkeletonEvent* events; u32 event_count; NYA_SkeletonSignal signals[NYA_SKELETON_CLIP_EVENTS]; u32 signal_count; s32 root_motion_bone; f32x3 root_motion_axes; b8 root_motion_rotation; NYA_RootMotion root_motion; }

// macros
NYA_SKELETON_LAYERS 4  // Layers one player may stack over its base clip.
NYA_SKELETON_CLIP_EVENTS 16  // Events one clip may carry.
nya_skeleton_player_play(player, clip, ...)

// functions
void nya_skeleton_mask_fill(const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton, f32 weight, OUT NYA_SkeletonMask* out_mask)  // A mask with every bone at `weight`.
b8 nya_skeleton_mask_from_bone(const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton, NYA_ConstCString root, OUT NYA_SkeletonMask* out_mask)  // A mask covering `root` and everything below it, at full weight, and nothing else.
void nya_skeleton_mask_set(const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton, NYA_SkeletonMask* mask, s32 bone, f32 weight, b8 include_descendants)  // Sets one bone's weight, and optionally everything below it.
void nya_skeleton_pose_blend_masked(const NYA_SkeletonPose* from, const NYA_SkeletonPose* to, f32 amount, const NYA_SkeletonMask* mask, OUT NYA_SkeletonPose* out_pose)  // Blends `to` over `from` per bone, scaled by `mask`.
void nya_skeleton_player_init(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton)  // Points the player at a skeleton and clears it.
void nya_skeleton_player_play_with_options(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, const NYA_SkeletonClip* clip, NYA_SkeletonPlayOptions options)  // Plays `clip`, crossfading from whatever was playing.
void nya_skeleton_player_events(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, const NYA_SkeletonEvent* events, u32 count)  // Attaches the event list a player fires from.
b8 nya_skeleton_player_layer(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, u32 slot, const NYA_SkeletonClip* clip, const NYA_SkeletonMask* mask, f32 weight, b8 looping)  // Starts a layer in `slot`, over the base.
void nya_skeleton_player_layer_stop(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, u32 slot)  // Stops a layer.
void nya_skeleton_player_layer_weight(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, u32 slot, f32 weight)  // Sets a running layer's weight, for fading one in or out by hand.
b8 nya_skeleton_player_root_motion(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, NYA_ConstCString bone, f32x3 translation_axes, b8 rotation)  // Turns root motion on for `bone`, or off when `bone` is null.
NYA_RootMotion nya_skeleton_player_root_delta(const NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player)  // What the last update extracted.
void nya_skeleton_player_update(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, f32 delta_time_s, OUT NYA_SkeletonPose* out_pose)  // Advances everything and writes the composed pose.
void nya_skeleton_player_inertial(NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player, NYA_SkeletonInertializer* inertializer)  // Transitions through `inertializer` instead of crossfading.
b8 nya_skeleton_player_fading(const NYA_SkeletonPlayer* player)  // Whether a transition is in progress, crossfade or inertialization.
b8 nya_skeleton_ik_two_bone(const NYA_Skeleton* skeleton, NYA_SkeletonPose* pose, s32 root_bone, s32 mid_bone, s32 end_bone, f32x3 target, f32x3 pole)  // Bends a two-bone chain so `end` reaches `target`, writing rotations into `pose`.
```

### core_system.h

One registry for every system in the process: the engine's subsystems, the game's, and a plugin's.

```c
// types
typedef u32 NYA_SystemFacilities  // A set of NYA_SystemFacility bits.
enum NYA_SystemPhase { NYA_SYSTEM_PHASE_FRAME, NYA_SYSTEM_PHASE_TICK, NYA_SYSTEM_PHASE_RENDER, NYA_SYSTEM_PHASE_COUNT, }  // When in the frame a callback runs.
enum NYA_SystemOwnerKind { NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_ENGINE, NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_GAME, NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_PLUGIN, NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_KIND_COUNT, }  // Who a system belongs to.
enum NYA_SystemFacility { NYA_SYSTEM_FACILITY_WINDOW = 1U << 0, NYA_SYSTEM_FACILITY_GPU = 1U << 1, NYA_SYSTEM_FACILITY_AUDIO = 1U << 2, NYA_SYSTEM_FACILITY_TERMINAL = 1U << 3, NYA_SYSTEM_FACILITY_LISTENER = 1U << 4, }  // Something a system can only run with, and that another system is what brings into the process.
struct NYA_SystemOwner { NYA_SystemOwnerKind kind; NYA_ConstCString plugin; }
struct NYA_SystemOwnerStats { NYA_ConstCString name; NYA_SystemOwnerKind kind; u32 system_count; u32 enabled_count; u64 time_ns; u64 memory_bytes; }  // What one owner's systems cost, summed over the systems belonging to it.
typedef NYA_Error (*NYA_SystemInitFn)(void)
typedef void (*NYA_SystemDeinitFn)(void)
typedef void (*NYA_SystemPhaseFn)(f32 delta_time_s)  // One phase's work for one system.
typedef u64 (*NYA_SystemMemoryFn)(void)  // What a system reports holding right now, for the per-owner memory line.
struct NYA_SystemEntry { NYA_ConstCString name; NYA_ConstCString after; NYA_ConstCString before; NYA_CallbackHandle init; NYA_CallbackHandle deinit; NYA_CallbackHandle frame; NYA_CallbackHandle tick; NYA_CallbackHandle render; b8 optional; NYA_SystemFacilities needs; NYA_SystemFacilities provides; NYA_SystemOwner owner; NYA_CallbackHandle memory_bytes; }

// macros
NYA_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_MAX 64  // How many systems can be registered at once.
NYA_SYSTEM_PENDING_MAX 16  // Registrations, removals and enable flips one phase run may queue before they are applied.
NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_MAX 16  // Distinct owners the registry accounts for: the engine, the game, and one per loaded plugin.
NYA_SYSTEM_NAME_MAX 40  // Bytes one name may take, terminator included.

// functions
void nya_system_register(NYA_SystemEntry entry)  // Adds `entry`, enabled, in the position `after` asks for.
void nya_system_unregister(NYA_ConstCString name)  // Removes the system called `name`.
void nya_system_enable(NYA_ConstCString name)  // Whether the system's phase callbacks run.
void nya_system_disable(NYA_ConstCString name)
b8 nya_system_is_enabled(NYA_ConstCString name)  // What those two last set.
NYA_Error nya_system_registry_finalize(void)  // Sorts every registered entry by `after` into the order the run functions use.
NYA_Error nya_system_registry_run_init(void)  // Runs every `init` in order, timing each one into the debug log.
void nya_system_registry_run(NYA_SystemPhase phase, f32 delta_time_s)  // Runs `phase` for every enabled system that has a callback for it, in finalized order.
void nya_system_registry_run_deinit(void)  // Runs `deinit` in reverse finalized order, for every system whose `init` ran and succeeded.
NYA_ConstCString nya_system_phase_name(NYA_SystemPhase phase)  // "frame", "tick" or "render".
NYA_ConstCString nya_system_owner_name(NYA_SystemOwner owner)  // "engine", "game", or the plugin's own name.
NYA_ConstCString nya_system_facility_name(NYA_SystemFacility facility)  // One facility as the noun a sentence takes: "a window", "a GPU device".
NYA_SystemFacilities nya_system_facilities(void)  // What is up in this process right now: every `provides` of every system whose `init` has succeeded.
void nya_system_facilities_provide(NYA_SystemFacilities facilities)
void nya_system_facilities_withdraw(NYA_SystemFacilities facilities)  // Takes them away again.
b8 nya_system_registry_is_running(void)  // Whether a phase run is in progress, which is what makes a mutation queue instead of apply.
void nya_system_registry_report(void)  // Logs the schedule at debug level, one line per phase, in run order, with a disabled system marked.
u32 nya_system_registry_count(void)  // How many systems are registered.
const NYA_SystemEntry* nya_system_registry_at(u32 index)  // The entry at `index`, in registration order before finalize and run order after it.
b8 nya_system_registry_enabled_at(u32 index)  // Whether the entry at `index` is enabled, and whether its `init` ran and succeeded.
b8 nya_system_registry_initialized_at(u32 index)
b8 nya_system_registry_runs_phase_at(u32 index, NYA_SystemPhase phase)  // Whether the entry at `index` has work in `phase`, which is what the overlay's phase column reads.
void nya_system_accounting_enable(void)
void nya_system_accounting_disable(void)
b8 nya_system_accounting_is_enabled(void)
void nya_system_accounting_frame_end(void)  // Publishes what was measured since the last call as "the last frame" and starts a new window.
u64 nya_system_registry_time_ns_at(u32 index)  // What the system at `index` cost over the last frame, summed across every phase it ran in.
u32 nya_system_owner_count(void)  // How many distinct owners have a system registered, at most NYA_SYSTEM_OWNER_MAX.
NYA_SystemOwnerStats nya_system_owner_stats_at(u32 index)  // One owner's totals.
```

### core_taskgroup.h

A scoped task group — a "nursery" — that fans work out onto the job pool and joins all of it at

```c
// types
typedef NYA_Error (*NYA_TaskFn)(void* arg, NYA_TaskGroup* group)  // What one task runs.

// functions
NYA_Error nya_taskgroup_begin(NYA_Arena* arena, u32 max_tasks, OUT NYA_TaskGroup** out_group)  // Opens a group out of `arena`, holding room for `max_tasks` tasks.
NYA_Error nya_taskgroup_spawn(NYA_TaskGroup* group, NYA_TaskFn function, void* arg)  // Queues `function` with `arg` onto the job pool under `group`.
void nya_taskgroup_end(NYA_TaskGroup* group, OUT NYA_Error* out_error)  // Joins every task spawned into `group` and writes the first failure into `out_error`.
void nya_taskgroup_cancel(NYA_TaskGroup* group)  // Raises `group`'s cancellation flag, asking its tasks to stop.
b8 nya_taskgroup_is_cancelled(const NYA_TaskGroup* group)  // Whether `group` has been cancelled, by a caller or by a task of its own failing.
```

### core_tween.h

```c
// types
struct NYA_Tween { u32 index; u32 generation; }  // Identifies a running tween.
typedef enum NYA_TweenTarget { NYA_TWEEN_TARGET_F32 = 0, NYA_TWEEN_TARGET_F32X2, NYA_TWEEN_TARGET_F32X3, NYA_TWEEN_TARGET_F32X4, NYA_TWEEN_TARGET_COUNT, } NYA_TweenTarget  // What a tween is animating.
struct NYA_TweenOptions { NYA_EaseType ease; f32 delay; u32 repeat; b8 yoyo; NYA_CallbackHandle on_complete; }  // Everything optional about a tween.
struct NYA_TweenSpec { NYA_TweenTarget target; void* address; f32 to_f32; f32x2 to_f32x2; f32x3 to_f32x3; f32x4 to_f32x4; f32 duration; NYA_TweenOptions options; }  // One entry in a timeline.
typedef void (*NYA_TweenOnCompleteFn)(void* address)  // The signature a completion callback must have.

// macros
NYA_TWEEN_MAX 512  // How many tweens can run at once.
NYA_TWEEN_NONE ((NYA_Tween){ .index = 0, .generation = 0 })
NYA_TWEEN_REPEAT_FOREVER 0xFFFFFFFFU  // Repeat count meaning "until cancelled".
nya_tween_f32(address, to, duration_s, ...)
nya_tween_f32x2(address, to, duration_s, ...)
nya_tween_f32x3(address, to, duration_s, ...)
nya_tween_f32x4(address, to, duration_s, ...)
nya_tween_spec_f32(address_, to_, duration_, ...)
nya_tween_spec_f32x2(address_, to_, duration_, ...)
nya_tween_spec_f32x3(address_, to_, duration_, ...)

// functions
void nya_system_tween_init(void)
void nya_system_tween_deinit(void)
void nya_system_tween_update(f32 delta_time_s)  // Advances every running tween.
NYA_Tween nya_tween_f32_with_options(f32* address, f32 to, f32 duration_s, NYA_TweenOptions options)
NYA_Tween nya_tween_f32x2_with_options(f32x2* address, f32x2 to, f32 duration_s, NYA_TweenOptions options)
NYA_Tween nya_tween_f32x3_with_options(f32x3* address, f32x3 to, f32 duration_s, NYA_TweenOptions options)
NYA_Tween nya_tween_f32x4_with_options(f32x4* address, f32x4 to, f32 duration_s, NYA_TweenOptions options)
NYA_Tween nya_tween_sequence(const NYA_TweenSpec* specs, u32 count)  // Starts `specs` one after another, each delayed by the total duration of those before it.
void nya_tween_cancel(NYA_Tween tween)  // Stops a tween, leaving the value where it is.
u32 nya_tween_cancel_target(const void* address)  // Stops every tween writing to `address`, leaving the value where it is.
void nya_tween_cancel_all(void)  // Stops everything.
b8 nya_tween_active(NYA_Tween tween)  // Whether the handle still names a running tween.
u32 nya_tween_count(void)  // How many tweens are running.
f32 nya_tween_progress(NYA_Tween tween)  // How far along a tween is, from 0 at its start value to 1 at its target.
```

### core_undo.h

A bounded undo/redo history over one reflected value.

```c
// macros
NYA_HISTORY_CAPACITY_MAX 1024  // The hard cap on how many snapshots a history can keep.

// functions
NYA_History* nya_history_create(NYA_Arena* arena, const NYA_TypeReflection* type, u32 capacity)  // A history over values of `type`, keeping at most `capacity` of them (clamped to NYA_HISTORY_CAPACITY_MAX).
void nya_history_destroy(NYA_History* history)  // Returns everything the history took from its arena — every snapshot, the slot table and the handle itself.
void nya_history_record(NYA_History* history, const void* value)  // Snapshots `value` and makes it the current state.
b8 nya_history_undo(NYA_History* history, OUT void* value)  // Steps back one entry and writes that earlier state over `value`.
b8 nya_history_redo(NYA_History* history, OUT void* value)  // Steps forward one entry and writes that later state over `value`.
u32 nya_history_count(const NYA_History* history)  // How many snapshots the ring is holding right now, redo tail included.
b8 nya_history_can_undo(const NYA_History* history)  // Whether nya_history_undo would produce a state, so a button can be greyed out without trying it.
b8 nya_history_can_redo(const NYA_History* history)  // Whether nya_history_redo would produce a state.
```

### math_quaternion.h

```c
// types
struct NYA_Quaternion { f32 x; f32 y; f32 z; f32 w; }

// macros
nya_quaternion_identity ((NYA_Quaternion){ 0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F, 1.0F })  // The rotation that does nothing.
NYA_QUATERNION_NLERP_THRESHOLD 0.99F  // How parallel two rotations must be before slerp falls back to nlerp, as a cosine.

// functions
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_create(f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 w)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_from_axis_angle(f32x3 axis, f32 radians)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_from_euler(f32 pitch, f32 yaw, f32 roll)  // Euler angles in radians, applied roll (Z), then pitch (X), then yaw (Y).
void nya_quaternion_to_euler(NYA_Quaternion quaternion, OUT f32* out_pitch, OUT f32* out_yaw, OUT f32* out_roll)  // Inverse of nya_quaternion_from_euler.
void nya_quaternion_to_axis_angle(NYA_Quaternion quaternion, OUT f32x3* out_axis, OUT f32* out_radians)  // Decomposes into the axis and angle it rotates about.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_from_to(f32x3 from, f32x3 to)  // Shortest rotation taking direction `from` to direction `to`.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_look(f32x3 direction, f32x3 up)  // Rotation whose -Z axis points along `direction` and whose Y axis is as close to `up` as possible.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_multiply(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b)  // Composition: applies `b` first, then `a`, matching the equivalent matrix product; does not commute.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_add(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_scale(NYA_Quaternion quaternion, f32 scalar)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_conjugate(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)  // Negates the vector part.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_inverse(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)  // True inverse, valid for non unit quaternions too.
f32 nya_quaternion_dot(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b)
f32 nya_quaternion_length(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)
f32 nya_quaternion_length_squared(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_normalize(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)  // Returns the identity for a zero quaternion rather than dividing by zero.
f32 nya_quaternion_angle_between(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b)  // Angle of the shortest rotation between two orientations, in radians.
b8 nya_quaternion_approx_equals(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b, f32 epsilon)
f32x3 nya_quaternion_rotate(NYA_Quaternion quaternion, f32x3 vector)  // Rotates `vector` by a unit `quaternion`.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_nlerp(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b, f32 t)  // Normalized linear interpolation: cheap, shortest arc, non-constant angular velocity.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_slerp(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b, f32 t)
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_slerp_unit(NYA_Quaternion a, NYA_Quaternion b, f32 t)  // The same, for rotations already known to be unit length.
f32_3x3 nya_quaternion_to_matrix3(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)
f32_4x4 nya_quaternion_to_matrix4(NYA_Quaternion quaternion)  // The 3x3 rotation in the upper left of an otherwise identity 4x4, ready to compose with a transform.
NYA_Quaternion nya_quaternion_from_matrix(f32_3x3 matrix)  // Expects a pure rotation matrix; scale or shear in `matrix` gives a meaningless result.
```

### math_shapes.h

```c
// types
struct NYA_Rectf { f32 x, y, width, height; }  // An axis aligned rectangle as minimum corner and size, the form draws and sprites already use.
struct NYA_Circlef { f32x2 center; f32 radius; }  // A circle, as a centre and a radius.

// functions
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_from_corners(f32x2 a, f32x2 b)  // From two opposite corners, in either order.
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_from_center(f32x2 center, f32x2 size)  // From a centre and a full size, not a half size.
f32x2 nya_rect_min(NYA_Rectf rect)  // The minimum corner: top left, in the engine's y-down screen space.
f32x2 nya_rect_max(NYA_Rectf rect)  // The maximum corner.
f32x2 nya_rect_center(NYA_Rectf rect)
f32x2 nya_rect_size(NYA_Rectf rect)
b8 nya_rect_is_empty(NYA_Rectf rect)  // Zero area, or negative extent on either axis.
f32 nya_rect_area(NYA_Rectf rect)  // width × height, and zero rather than negative for an empty rectangle.
b8 nya_rect_contains(NYA_Rectf rect, f32x2 point)  // Half open: `x <= point.x < x + width`, same on y.
b8 nya_rect_contains_rect(NYA_Rectf outer, NYA_Rectf inner)  // Whether `inner` is entirely within `outer`.
b8 nya_rect_overlaps(NYA_Rectf a, NYA_Rectf b)  // Whether the two share any point.
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_intersection(NYA_Rectf a, NYA_Rectf b)  // The shared region, or an empty rectangle when there is none.
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_union(NYA_Rectf a, NYA_Rectf b)  // The smallest rectangle containing both.
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_expand(NYA_Rectf rect, f32 amount)  // Grows by `amount` on every side, so the width gains twice it.
NYA_Rectf nya_rect_translate(NYA_Rectf rect, f32x2 offset)
f32x2 nya_rect_closest_point(NYA_Rectf rect, f32x2 point)  // The point in `rect` closest to `point`.
b8 nya_circle_contains(NYA_Circlef circle, f32x2 point)  // Half open at the rim, matching the rectangle: a point exactly `radius` away is outside.
b8 nya_circle_overlaps(NYA_Circlef a, NYA_Circlef b)
b8 nya_circle_overlaps_rect(NYA_Circlef circle, NYA_Rectf rect)  // Compares against the closest point on the rectangle, so a corner is handled like any other.
NYA_Rectf nya_circle_bounds(NYA_Circlef circle)  // The rectangle that just contains the circle.
```

## renderer

2D and 3D drawing, cameras, text, particles, post processing and render targets.

### render2d.h

```c
// types
struct NYA_Render2DTexture { f32 source_x, source_y, source_width, source_height; f32 x, y; f32 width, height; f32 rotation; f32x2 origin; b8 flip_x; b8 flip_y; NYA_Color tint; }
typedef enum NYA_NineSliceFill { NYA_NINE_SLICE_STRETCH = 0, NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILE, NYA_NINE_SLICE_FILL_COUNT, } NYA_NineSliceFill  // How the edges and the centre cover the length between the corners.
struct NYA_NineSlice { f32 left, right, top, bottom; f32 x, y, width, height; f32 source_x, source_y, source_width, source_height; f32 scale; NYA_NineSliceFill fill; b8 hollow; NYA_Color tint; }
struct NYA_NineSliceAxis { u32 count; f32 source[NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX + 2]; f32 source_size[NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX + 2]; f32 destination[NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX + 2]; f32 destination_size[NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX + 2]; b8 middle[NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX + 2]; }  // A nine-slice cut along one axis: the start border, the middle pieces, and the end border, in order.
enum NYA_TextAlign { NYA_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT = 0, NYA_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, NYA_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, NYA_TEXT_ALIGN_COUNT, }  // Where a line sits within the box's width.
struct NYA_Render2DTextBox { f32 x, y; f32 width; NYA_TextAlign align; f32 line_spacing; u32 max_lines; b8 ellipsis; NYA_Color color; NYA_ConstCString font_path; f32 point_size; }  // A block of text laid out in a box: wrapped to a width, aligned, and optionally truncated.
struct NYA_Light2D { f32 radius; f32 intensity; NYA_Color color; f32x2 offset; }  // What an entity emits, if anything.
struct NYA_Render2DFrameStats { u32 draw_calls; u32 vertices; u32 indices; u32 draw_calls_by_reason[NYA_RENDER2D_FLUSH_REASON_COUNT]; u32 dropped_draws; }

// macros
NYA_RENDER2D_FONT_DEFAULT_SIZE 24.0F  // Point size used when a call passes zero or a negative size.
NYA_RENDER2D_TEXT_MAX 512
NYA_RENDER2D_MAX_VERTICES 32768
NYA_RENDER2D_MAX_INDICES (NYA_RENDER2D_MAX_VERTICES * 2)  // Indices held before a flush is forced.
NYA_RENDER2D_CIRCLE_SEGMENTS 64  // Segments used to approximate a full circle.
NYA_NINE_SLICE_TILES_MAX 16  // The most middle pieces a tiled nine-slice cuts along one axis.
NYA_RENDER2D_PIPELINE_LIGHT "nya_light2d_pipeline"  // The handle the built in light pipeline is registered under.

// functions
void nya_render2d_shutdown(void)  // Releases everything the drawing module holds that is not tied to a window.
void nya_render2d_flush(NYA_Window* window)  // Uploads and draws everything accumulated so far, then empties the batch.
void nya_render2d_rect(NYA_Window* window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height, NYA_Color color)  // A filled axis aligned rectangle, `x`/`y` being its top left corner.
void nya_render2d_rect_gradient(NYA_Window* window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height, const NYA_Color corners[4])
void nya_render2d_rect_outline(NYA_Window* window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height, f32 thickness, NYA_Color color)  // A rectangle outline of `thickness`, drawn inside the given bounds.
void nya_render2d_rect_rounded(NYA_Window* window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height, f32 radius, NYA_Color color)  // A filled rectangle with corners of `radius`, clamped to half the shorter side.
void nya_render2d_rect_rounded_outline(NYA_Window* window, f32 x, f32 y, f32 width, f32 height, f32 radius, f32 thickness, NYA_Color color)  // The outline of that rectangle, `thickness` wide and inside the bounds, as one ring.
void nya_render2d_rect_rotated(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 center, f32x2 size, f32 rotation, NYA_Color color)  // A filled rectangle turned about its own centre.
void nya_render2d_rect_rotated_outline(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 center, f32x2 size, f32 rotation, f32 thickness, NYA_Color color)  // The outline of that rectangle, as four lines of `thickness` along its edges.
void nya_render2d_line(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 from, f32x2 to, f32 thickness, NYA_Color color)  // A line of `thickness`, as a quad.
void nya_render2d_polyline(NYA_Window* window, const f32x2* points, u32 count, f32 thickness, NYA_Color color)  // Connects `count` points with lines of `thickness`, in order and without closing the loop.
void nya_render2d_triangle(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 a, f32x2 b, f32x2 c, NYA_Color color)  // A filled triangle.
void nya_render2d_circle(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 center, f32 radius, NYA_Color color)  // A filled circle centred on `center`, as a fan of triangles.
void nya_render2d_camera_set(NYA_Window* window, NYA_Camera2DTopDown camera)  // Looks at the world from `camera` for everything drawn afterwards.
void nya_render2d_camera_isometric_set(NYA_Window* window, NYA_Camera2DIsometric camera)  // The same through an isometric projection.
void nya_render2d_camera_reset(NYA_Window* window)  // Back to screen pixels, origin at the target's top left.
NYA_Camera2D nya_render2d_camera_get(NYA_Window* window)  // The camera currently in effect, tagged with which kind it is.
NYA_Camera2DTopDown nya_render2d_camera_top_down_get(NYA_Window* window)  // The current camera as a top-down one, or the identity when it is not one.
f32x2 nya_render2d_screen_to_world(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 screen)  // Where a point on screen is in the world, under the current camera.
f32x2 nya_render2d_world_to_screen(NYA_Window* window, f32x2 world)  // Where a world point lands on screen.
void nya_render2d_texture(NYA_Window* window, NYA_ConstCString texture_handle, f32 x, f32 y, NYA_Color tint)  // Draws a whole texture asset at its natural size, top left at `x`/`y`.
void nya_render2d_texture_ex(NYA_Window* window, NYA_ConstCString texture_handle, NYA_Render2DTexture params)  // The general textured draw: rotation, a pivot, mirroring and scaling.
void nya_render2d_texture_rect( NYA_Window* window, NYA_ConstCString texture_handle, f32 source_x, f32 source_y, f32 source_width, f32 source_height, f32 destination_x, f32 destination_y, f32 destination_width, f32 destination_height, NYA_Color tint )
void nya_render2d_nine_slice(NYA_Window* window, NYA_ConstCString texture_handle, NYA_NineSlice params)  // Draws `texture_handle` as a nine-slice.
void nya_render2d_nine_slice_axis( f32 source_start, f32 source_length, f32 border_start, f32 border_end, f32 destination_start, f32 destination_length, f32 scale, NYA_NineSliceFill fill, OUT NYA_NineSliceAxis* out_axis )
void nya_render2d_font_set(NYA_ConstCString font_path, f32 point_size)  // Sets the font every later nya_render2d_text and measurement uses.
```

```c
// types

struct NYA_Sprite { NYA_ConstCString texture; f32 source_x, source_y, source_width, source_height; f32x2 origin; f32x2 scale; f32 rotation; b8 flip_x; b8 flip_y; NYA_Color tint; }  // One drawable thing: where in a texture it is, and how it should be put on screen.
struct NYA_SpriteList { const NYA_ConstCString* textures; u32 count; }  // Frames as separate images, one texture each, instead of cells of one sheet.
enum NYA_SpriteAnimationSignalKind { NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_STARTED = 0, NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_EVENT, NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_LOOPED, NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_FINISHED, NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_SIGNAL_KIND_COUNT, }
struct NYA_SpriteAnimationEvent { u32 frame; u32 id; }  // A marker on one frame of an animation.
struct NYA_SpriteAnimation { u32 first_frame; u32 frame_count; f32 frames_per_second; b8 looping; b8 ping_pong; const NYA_SpriteAnimationEvent* events; u32 event_count; }  // A span of frames and how fast to play them.
struct NYA_SpriteAnimationSignal { NYA_SpriteAnimationSignalKind kind; u32 frame; u32 id; }  // What one advance produced.
struct NYA_SpriteAnimator { const NYA_SpriteAnimation* animation; f32 frame_elapsed_s; u32 frame; f32 speed; b8 playing; b8 finished; b8 reversing; u32 loops; b8 pending_start; }  // Where in an animation something is.

// macros

NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_MAX_EVENTS 16  // Most frame markers one animation may carry.
NYA_SPRITE_ANIMATION_DEFAULT_FPS 12.0F  // Frames per second for an animation that does not say.

// functions

void nya_sprite_animator_resume(OUT NYA_SpriteAnimator* animator)
void nya_sprite_animator_stop(OUT NYA_SpriteAnimator* animator)  // Stops and forgets the animation.

u32 nya_sprite_animator_frame(const NYA_SpriteAnimator* animator)  // The atlas frame the animator is showing.
void nya_sprite_animator_apply(const NYA_SpriteAnimator* animator, const NYA_SpriteAtlas* atlas, OUT NYA_Sprite* sprite)  // Points `sprite` at the animator's current frame of `atlas`.

NYA_SpriteAtlas nya_sprite_atlas_grid_padded(NYA_ConstCString texture, u32 frame_width, u32 frame_height, u32 spacing, u32 margin)  // Same, for a sheet exported with padding between cells or a border around them.

void nya_sprite_atlas_frame_rect(const NYA_SpriteAtlas* atlas, u32 frame, OUT f32* out_x, OUT f32* out_y, OUT f32* out_width, OUT f32* out_height)  // Where a frame sits in the texture, in its pixels.

NYA_Sprite nya_sprite_from_atlas(const NYA_SpriteAtlas* atlas, u32 frame)  // A sprite showing one frame of an atlas, centred, unflipped and untinted.

void nya_sprite_set_frame(OUT NYA_Sprite* sprite, const NYA_SpriteAtlas* atlas, u32 frame)  // Points an existing sprite at another frame, keeping its flip, tint, scale and rotation.
```

```c
// types

enum NYA_FoliageStyle { NYA_FOLIAGE_GRASS = 0, NYA_FOLIAGE_LEAVES, NYA_FOLIAGE_BRANCHES, NYA_FOLIAGE_STYLE_COUNT, }  // The three foliage looks, all one shader and one wind field apart only in the parameters below.
struct NYA_Render3DFoliage { f32x3 wind; f32 time; f32 amplitude; f32 frequency; f32 stiffness; f32 flutter; f32 detail_frequency; f32 phase; NYA_Color tint; }  // How one plant sways.

NYA_RENDER3D_FOG_COLOR ((NYA_Color){ 0.66F, 0.72F, 0.78F, 1.0F })  // What NYA_Render3DFog.color falls back to: a pale desaturated blue.
```

### render_camera.h

```c
// types
struct NYA_Camera2DTopDown { f32x2 position; f32 zoom; f32 rotation; }  // Straight down at a flat world.
struct NYA_Camera2DIsometric { f32x2 position; f32 zoom; f32 tile_width; f32 tile_height; }  // The same flat world seen along a diagonal, so a square tile draws as a diamond.
enum NYA_Camera2DKind { NYA_CAMERA2D_KIND_NONE = 0, NYA_CAMERA2D_KIND_TOP_DOWN, NYA_CAMERA2D_KIND_ISOMETRIC, }  // Which of the two 2D projections a camera is.
struct NYA_Camera2D { NYA_Camera2DKind kind; union { NYA_Camera2DTopDown as_top_down; NYA_Camera2DIsometric as_isometric; }; }  // Whichever 2D camera is currently set, tagged.
struct NYA_Camera3DPerspective { f32x3 position; f32x3 target; f32x3 up; f32 fov_y; f32 near_plane; f32 far_plane; }  // A 3D camera with vanishing points: things get smaller with distance.
struct NYA_Camera3DOrthographic { f32x3 position; f32x3 target; f32x3 up; f32 height; f32 near_plane; f32 far_plane; }  // A 3D camera without vanishing points: parallel lines stay parallel, size ignores distance.

// functions

void nya_camera2d_basis(const NYA_Camera2D* camera, OUT f32* out_a, OUT f32* out_b, OUT f32* out_c, OUT f32* out_d)  // The 2x2 a camera applies to a world offset, before the view centre is added.
f32x2 nya_camera2d_position(const NYA_Camera2D* camera)  // The world (or tile) point the camera centres on, whichever kind it is.
f32x2 nya_camera2d_screen_to_world(const NYA_Camera2D* camera, f32x2 screen, u32 target_width, u32 target_height)  // The two conversions between the target's pixels and the camera's world.
f32x2 nya_camera2d_world_to_screen(const NYA_Camera2D* camera, f32x2 world, u32 target_width, u32 target_height)
```
